comments.author: @chrisstephens2107
comments.text: Blaming tariffs for the massive ps5 price increase is just an excuse for greedy companies. Tariffs are a temporary measure to force a country to the table with the stated objective of ZERO TARRIFS across the board, also known as free trade. I never hear anybody complain about the massive tariffs against the United States by every other country taking advantage of us but the second president Trump attempts to use them as leverage to get them removed everyone acts like a nuke went off. This is economics 101. Countries who are profiting off of massive tariffs against the US don't want to renegotiate because its"free money" for doing nothing for them, so the only way to get them to make a fair deal is to force them to the negotiating table using leverage(tariffs). President Trump loves to use tariffs because it is wholly within the power of the presidency to use and enforce and has already been defined and settled by the courts as such. The price increases caused by tariffs are temporary and amount to a drop in the bucket compared to the benefits of free trade across the board. There is also a secondary benefit to this tactic which is all companies looking to bypass all tariffs open up businesses and factories in America. This is positive for the population by way of added jobs and competition for employees, which is a great way to increase wages in a free market.
